sections.title: Growth and habitat
sections.text: Polytrichum piliferum is a tuft-forming moss usually about 2–3 cm tall, found in open, sunny and acidic places.

sections.title: Leaves and sporophytes
sections.text: Some leaves bear a distinctive long, white, translucent hairpoint; their margins are entire. Sporophyte capsules are also shown on the plate.
